description: Read bounded placement totals and result metrics for the calling participant. Optional participantRole selects BRAND or CREATOR when the current account has both roles; the server verifies that role. Optional ISO from/to timestamps bound the period; from must precede to. Financial fields follow that participant’s safe projection; results include views, likes, shares, comments, and ER, without clicks. Requires read scope. The Public API applies current tenant, role, account-access, and object permissions. Pass only IDs returned to this API key; the server derives the acting user and account.
name: vibevo_get_placement_analytics
title: Get placement analytics
